item.title: Selena Gomez’s Attorney Calls Investor Fraud Lawsuit Allegations ‘Meritless’
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome back to Trending on Billboard, the latest on music and entertainment news. Today, we're talking about Selena Gomez and a lawsuit surrounding her mental health startup, Wondermind. Let's dive in."
[Music transitions]
Host: "The lawsuit, filed on behalf of five investors, claims that Selena Gomez, her mother Mandy Teefey, and former executive Danielle Pierson misled them into investing $1.2 million in Wondermind. The investors are seeking the return of their investment, plus additional damages."
[Short pause]
Host: "But Selena Gomez's lawyer, Mathew S. Rosengart, says these allegations are 'baseless' and 'completely meritless'. He's planning to file a motion to dismiss the claims. According to Rosengart, Gomez did not engage in any wrongdoing and will 'vigorously defend these false allegations'."
[Music transitions]
Host: "So, what's the story behind Wondermind? The company was launched in 2021 as a suite of mental health media initiatives, including a digital magazine, mobile app, and podcast. The investors claim they were promised that Gomez would be actively involved as the head of marketing, leveraging her massive fanbase to promote the company."
[Short pause]
Host: "But things took a turn when an exposé was published by The Cut, revealing a troubled financial state at Wondermind. The lawsuit claims that the defendants had made false promises, including a potential future valuation of over $4 billion and partnerships with major companies like JPMorgan and Fidelity."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's the latest on Selena Gomez and the Wondermind lawsuit. We'll be keeping an eye on this story as it develops. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. We'll catch you on the next one!"
[Outro music continues to play]
